caption: The drawing features a single object, a ladle, depicted in a black and white pencil or charcoal medium. The ladle is positioned diagonally from the lower right to the upper left of the rectangular frame. It has a long, straight handle that ends in a slightly flared, squared-off tip, and a round, deep bowl at the base. The handle appears to have gentle contours and a slightly raised junction where it meets the bowl. Light and shadow are used to suggest roundness and reflection on the surface of the ladle, indicating it is metallic. The composition is centered within a bordered rectangular area on an off-white background, and no other objects or details are present.
title: Pewter Ladle
